nina: Quick note from today's pairing session — we hit three surprising behaviors in the multi-region write path simulation and need to decide which to fix in control-plane vs dataplane.
omar: quick TL;DR of the behaviors?
nina: 1) split-view routing: two proxies had different resident lists for same tenant and both succeeded on writes. 2) oscillating escape: proxies flip escape_allowed frequently during intermittent packet loss. 3) runaway escrow: when escape mode triggers, escrow records accumulate fast and reconciler lags.
marcus: For 1, we should treat it as an availability win but add deterministic conflict markers so reconciliation is simpler. Gateways to tag writes with `escape_tag` or `resident_seq`.
liam: Agree. Implementation idea: resident gateways include a monotonic seq per shard `resident_seq`. If fallback accepts, it writes with `escape_seq=0` and creates an escrow entry pointing to origin proxy + trace. Reconciler sees resident_seq > 0 and can prefer resident when it appears.
sre-jen: Important: add metrics `escrow.pending` and `escrow.fulfillment_latency` and an alert when pending > 5000 or 99p fulfillment > 3600s. Also add cost estimate for 1M escrows.
omar: For 2 (oscillating escape), hysteresis is key. Proxies should require sustained failure for T_down=60s before enabling escape, and T_up=300s stable before clearing escape state. Also a per-tenant token-bucket to limit escape writes: burst=3, refill=1/min.
marcus: API boundary question: should proxies be authoritative for toggling escape state, or should they request a temporary override from control-plane?
ina: If control-plane round-trip adds >100ms, that will be in critical path. I'm leaning to proxies making local decisions with immediate telemetry back to control plane and a control-plane override capability for manual ops.
liam: For Private installs we may need push override hooks. We can support poll-by-default and optional push streams for on-prem. Keep semantics identical.
sre-jen: For 3 (runaway escrow) add a safety: if reconciler lag > threshold then proxies should switch to audit-only mode where fallback writes are rejected with `ERR_RESIDENCY_ESCALATE` and logged for manual review. Also backpressure: limit concurrent escrow creations per shard.
omar: Ops tooling: add a `tenant-residency` dashboard showing percent writes resident vs escaped, escrow backlog, and top tenants by escape-rate.
marcus: Developer action items: 1) add `resident_seq` header on gateway accepts, 2) gate proxy escape with hysteresis + token-bucket, 3) add escrow lifecycle doc (TTL, compaction, cost), 4) telemetry + runbook. I'll make issues.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: small canary of proxy-hysteresis v0.1 rolling to staging. Watch `proxy.escape.toggled` and `escrow.pending`.
sre-jen: One more ask: make gateway rejections explicit and user-friendly: `CODE_RESIDENCY_VIOLATION` + suggested remediation (retry to regional gateway or contact support).
marcus: Good call. We'll include that in API errors RFC. Meeting adjourned — will follow up with RFC drafts. :white_check_mark:
